svg.title: RB2.1 — 04 DPP Canva v11: tab faces populated
svg.desc: The DPP Canva with the four tab faces populated. Product specifications carries the product name, manufacturer and serial. Usage history shows lifetime energy, distance and hours. Environmental impact shows the four scenario carbon figures. Training disassembly shows five steps, ten actions and about five minutes. All tile contents are vertically centred.
svg.text: RECYCLER — headline chips only, one standard element
Authored icons in place: certificates (badge + modal), product specs, environmental, usage history, training
Filenames renamed to match the tab they serve - mechanical_data, recycler_user, usage_profile and service_repair
no longer describe what they show here, and a builder calling LoadTileIcon(recycler_user) for Environmental
impact would mislead every future reader
CLASH: the recycling arrows are already ic_recycler on the stakeholder screen - one glyph, two meanings
